commonMistakes.tr: Rezervasyonu yanlis scope altinda olusturmak veya MAC adresini yanlis formatta girmek cok yaygindir.
commonMistakes.en: Creating a reservation in the wrong scope or using an invalid MAC format is very common.

verificationChecks.tr: Dogru scope, address pool, mevcut lease kayitlari, MAC formati ve DHCP servis durumunu kontrol et.
verificationChecks.en: Verify correct scope, address pool, existing leases, MAC format, and DHCP service status.

expertTips.tr: Pool disi IP secme ve mevcut lease ile cakisma en sik hatadir; rezervasyon sonrasi istemcide ipconfig /renew yap.
expertTips.en: Picking an IP outside the pool or conflicting with an existing lease is common; run ipconfig /renew after reservation.

riskWarnings.tr: Aktif lease varken ayni IP'ye rezervasyon vermek cakismaya yol acabilir.
riskWarnings.en: Reserving an IP already in use by an active lease can cause conflicts.

verificationChecks.tr: Scope options, lease suresi ve failover/replication durumunu gozden gecir.
verificationChecks.en: Review scope options, lease duration, and failover/replication state.
